text: This looks like Brinjal little leaf. I do not have a verified medicine to give you for it, so please do not spray anything on guesswork. There are things you can do today. 1. Uproot and destroy diseased plants as soon as they are seen, including plants in neighbouring plots and on bunds, before planting a new crop. 2. Keep the field and surrounds clear of weed hosts, particularly Datura and periwinkle (Vinca rosea), which act as reservoirs. 3. Manage the leafhopper vector culturally with yellow sticky traps and by avoiding overlapping brinjal plantings. For a spray, ask your Krishi Vigyan Kendra.
